1: // Orbit Dodge game – minimal implementation
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Set canvas size to match displayed size
9:   const w = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
10:   const h = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
11: 
12:   // Audio setup
13:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
14:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
15:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     osc.type = 'sine';
19:     osc.connect(gain);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
23:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
26:   }
27:   // Background hum (low frequency pulsing)
28:   setInterval(() => playTone(80, 0.3), 3000);
29: 
30:   // Generate a simple star field for background
31:   const starCount = 100;
32:   const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => ({
33:     x: Math.random() * w,
34:     y: Math.random() * h,
35:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
36:   }));
37: 
38:   // Player ship
39:   const ship = {
40:     x: w / 2,
41:     y: h / 2,
42:     r: 10,
43:     speed: 2,
44:     dx: 0,
45:     dy: 0,
46:   };
47: 
48:   // Input handling (WASD / Arrow keys)
49:   const keys = {};
50:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
51:     // Resume AudioContext on first user interaction (required by browsers)
52:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
53:     keys[e.key] = true;
54:   });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
56: 
57:   function updateShip() {
58:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
59:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.dy = -1;
60:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.dy = 1;
61:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.dx = -1;
62:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.dx = 1;
63:     // Normalize diagonal movement
64:     if (ship.dx && ship.dy) {
65:       ship.dx *= Math.SQRT1_2;
66:       ship.dy *= Math.SQRT1_2;
67:     }
68:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(w - ship.r, ship.x + ship.dx * ship.speed));
69:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(h - ship.r, ship.y + ship.dy * ship.speed));
70:   }
71: 
72:   // Orbiting circles definition
73:   const rings = [
74:     { radius: 80, count: 4, speed: 0.01 },
75:     { radius: 130, count: 6, speed: -0.015 },
76:     { radius: 180, count: 8, speed: 0.02 },
77:   ];
78: 
79:   // Generate orbiting objects
80:   const orbits = [];
81:   rings.forEach(ring => {
82:     for (let i = 0; i < ring.count; i++) {
83:       const angle = (i / ring.count) * Math.PI * 2;
84:       orbits.push({
85:         radius: ring.radius,
86:         angle,
87:         speed: ring.speed,
88:         r: 15,
89:       });
90:     }
91:   });
92: 
93:   function updateOrbits() {
94:     orbits.forEach(o => {
95:       o.angle += o.speed;
96:     });
97:   }
98: 
99:   function drawShip() {
100:     // Ship is drawn as a triangle facing movement direction
101:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.dy || 0, ship.dx || 0);
102:     ctx.save();
103:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
104:     ctx.rotate(angle);
105:     const size = ship.r * 2;
106:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
107:     ctx.beginPath();
108:     ctx.moveTo(0, -size / 2);
109:     ctx.lineTo(size / 2, size / 2);
110:     ctx.lineTo(-size / 2, size / 2);
111:     ctx.closePath();
112:     ctx.fill();
113:     ctx.restore();
114:   }
115: 
116:   // Draw background stars
117:   function drawStars() {
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
119:     stars.forEach(s => {
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
122:       ctx.fill();
123:     });
124:   }
125:     // Draw ship as a triangle pointing in movement direction
126:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.dy || 0, ship.dx || 0);
127:     ctx.save();
128:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
129:     ctx.rotate(angle);
130:     const size = ship.r * 2;
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.moveTo(0, -size / 2);
134:     ctx.lineTo(size / 2, size / 2);
135:     ctx.lineTo(-size / 2, size / 2);
136:     ctx.closePath();
137:     ctx.fill();
138:     ctx.restore();
139:   }
140: 
141:   function drawOrbits() {
142:     // Draw orbiting obstacles with a subtle glow
143:     orbits.forEach(o => {
144:       const x = w / 2 + Math.cos(o.angle) * o.radius;
145:       const y = h / 2 + Math.sin(o.angle) * o.radius;
146:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, o.r * 0.2, x, y, o.r);
147:       // color based on radius (different rings)
148:       const hue = 200 + (o.radius % 120);
149:       grad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${hue}, 80%, 60%, 0.9)`);
150:       grad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${hue}, 80%, 40%, 0.4)`);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.arc(x, y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
154:       ctx.fill();
155:     });
156:   }
157: 
158:   function checkCollision() {
159:     for (const o of orbits) {
160:       const x = w / 2 + Math.cos(o.angle) * o.radius;
161:       const y = h / 2 + Math.sin(o.angle) * o.radius;
162:       const dx = ship.x - x;
163:       const dy = ship.y - y;
164:       const dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
165:       const radSum = ship.r + o.r;
166:       if (dist2 < radSum * radSum) return true;
167:     }
168:     return false;
169:   }
170: 
171:   let start = performance.now();
172:   let gameOver = false;
173: 
174:   function loop(timestamp) {
175:     const delta = timestamp - start;
176:     start = timestamp;
177: 
178:     if (!gameOver) {
179:       updateShip();
180:       updateOrbits();
181:       if (checkCollision()) {
182:         gameOver = true;
183:         console.log('Game Over! Survived', Math.floor(delta / 1000), 'seconds');
184:         // Play collision / game over sound
185:         playTone(300, 0.3);
186:       }
187:     }
188: 
189:     // Dark background
190:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
191:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
192:     // stars
193:     drawStars();
194:     // draw static central point for reference
195:     ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
196:     ctx.beginPath();
197:     ctx.arc(w / 2, h / 2, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
198:     ctx.fill();
199:     drawOrbits();
200:     drawShip();
201: 
202:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
203:     else {
204:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
205:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
206:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
207:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
208:     }
209:   }
210: 
211:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
212: })();
